items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It was kind of a Glenn Miller band, wasn't it? [INTERVIEWEE] Similar.

ctx.x: Right. Ford Motor Company or one of those. He was from Detroit I know. He had automobile money behind him. Bob didn't live like a very rich man; I don't think he had his family's money while he was a band leader. He may have done that against the family wishes; maybe they chopped him off. I really don't know, but he was a nice guy, he was a very decent sort of person, easy going, gave nobody problems.
It was kind of a Glenn Miller band, wasn't it?
